name: Kessie
bio: Kessie is a powerhouse with a heart of gold. This Bulldog doesn't let anything slow her down — if she jumps, she jumps. She's fearless on runs, surprisingly fast for her stocky build, and will bulldoze her way right into your heart. Kessie loves treats, belly rubs, and showing off her vertical leap.

name: Buddy
bio: Buddy is a Shih Tzu with one true passion — food. This little guy will do absolutely anything for a treat. He's mastered sit, shake, roll over, and "look cute until you share your lunch." Buddy is a chill running companion who prefers a moderate pace with snack breaks. He's house-trained, great with kids, and will love you forever if you keep the treats coming.

name: Goldburger
bio: Goldburger is a Standard Poodle with zero shame and maximum personality. He's affectionate to a fault — and yes, he loves humping. Everything. Everyone. No leg is safe. But beneath that enthusiasm is a smart, loyal, and incredibly athletic dog who absolutely crushes it on runs. Goldburger is working on his manners, but honestly, we love him exactly as he is.

name: Biscuit
bio: Biscuit is a Corgi with short legs and big dreams. Viva la Munch — this guy lives to eat and runs like his next meal depends on it. Don't let those little legs fool you, Biscuit can keep up with the best of them. He's got a huge personality packed into a compact body, and his fluffy butt wiggle will make your whole day.
